records.title: National Capacity alignment plan for airport infrastructure
details: a to e: As per Greenfield Airports (GFA) Policy, 2008, "In-Principle'' approval has been accorded for setting up of 25 Greenfield Airports, out of which 13 have been operationalised and remaining are at different stages of development namely Doloo in Assam, Puri in Odisha, Parandur in Tamil Nadu, Kota in Rajashtan, Vijayapura and Hassan in Karnataka, Dabra (Gwalior) in Madhya Pradesh, Noida (Jewar) in Uttar Pradesh, Dholera in Gujarat, Karaikal in Puducherry, Dagadarthi and Bhogapuram in Andhra Pradesh

records.title: Technology Development Fund Scheme.
details: b: The process of the selection and identification of Deep Tech projects has been initiated.

records.title: Manufacturing/Sale of Fake Food Products.
details: अभी देश में जैसा माननीय संसद सदस्य कह रहे थे, 205 फूड टेस्टिंग लेबोरेट्रीज हैं, जिनको लगभग 503.47 करोड रुपये की लागत से बनाया गया है, उनमें से 169 प्रोजेक्ट्स अभी तक कंप्लीट हो चुके हैं। 100 नये फूड टेस्टिंग लैब्स को आने वाले दिनों में देश भर में लाया जाएगा।

records.title: Welfare of GIG and Platform Workers.
details: a to d: A Committee comprising representatives from stakeholders has been constituted to suggest inter alia framework for providing social security and welfare benefits to gig and platform workers.
